notes.subject: הסיר ... וחסדו
notes.rationale: One verb governs two objects: 'turned not away my prayer nor his khesed from me'; the repeated verb must be supplied in Tok Pisin (bracketed ⟨i no pulim⟩).

notes.subject: khesed
notes.rationale: חסד kept as 'khesed' per discipline, not 'marimari' alone.

notes.subject: מאתי
notes.rationale: מאתי contains the את nearness-marker with 1cs suffix — 'from with me'; aleph-tav shape preserved in gloss.

translation: Blessim olgeta Elohim, we em i no tromoiwe preg bilong mi, na khesed bilong em, ⟨i no pulim⟩ long mi ⟨את⟩.
